title: Import Picture Items
intro: Upload a CSV file together with a zip file of images to add many Picture Items at once. The CSV's "file" column must exactly match the file name in the zip. Every row and every file is validated; if there is one failure, nothing is saved.
templateHint: The template has the column headers and one example row with file name "example.jpg" and subsubcategoryId "0" -- replace that example row with your own rows before uploading the file.

errors.header: The column headers do not match the template.
errors.tooManyRows: The file has too many rows (maximum 200).
errors.parseError: The file could not be read as CSV.
errors.csvTooLarge: The CSV file is too large (maximum 1 MB).
errors.zipTooLarge: The zip file is too large (maximum 20 MB).
errors.zipParseError: The zip file could not be read.
errors.fileMissing: No file in the zip with this name.
errors.fileUnused: The file "{file}" in the zip is not named by any row.
errors.fileNotImage: This file is not a valid image.
